caption: The video captures a close-up nighttime view of a wood fire already burning steadily. Several logs and thin sticks are piled at an angle above a bright glowing ember bed, with a dark metal grate-like structure fixed on the right. Tall yellow-white flames rise continuously from the center, deforming and flickering without settling into a stable form. The main flame body shifts laterally, sending tongues toward the left before contracting back into a more vertical central plume. A separate small flame and a faint bluish glow appear intermittently near the thick log on the right. Thin grayish smoke wisps drift upward above the flames, becoming more noticeable over time. The surrounding log arrangement and ember bed remain unchanged while the fire continues to burn.
